title: Grusch approaches Knapp and Corbell at a bar at the SCU event

tellings.quote: What happened is we were in Rocket City, Alabama.

plain: The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says that at an event in Rocket City, as Huntsville, Alabama is known, held by the SCU, a group of researchers who study unexplained aerial reports, David Grusch came up to him and the journalist George Knapp at a bar. Grusch is a former intelligence officer who filed a complaint with the inspector general of the intelligence community, the watchdog over US spy agencies, saying the government hides UFO programmes. Corbell tells it as something he was there for, with the scientist Garry Nolan also part of the story, and it marks how Grusch first reached the reporters who would help him go public.
